pillars.title: Getting Started
pillars.description: The practical first steps of teaching at home — what to do in the first month, what to keep records of, and what genuinely does not matter as much as new homeschoolers fear.

pillars.title: Curriculum
pillars.description: Honest comparisons of homeschool curricula — what each one actually teaches, what worldview it carries, how it expects you to teach, and who it is not for.

pillars.title: Every Kind of Learner
pillars.description: Homeschooling when the standard advice does not fit — the child who fights worksheets, the child who is far ahead or far behind, and the parent teaching around a full-time job.
